text.card: A star about 52 parsecs away, 3.9 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.9 solar radii and 1.96 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,470 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Omicron Geminorum
quotes.card: Omicron Geminorum, also named Jishui, is a solitary star in the constellation of Gemini.
quotes.introduction: It is faintly visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 4.90.
